content:
deploy-bot: Starting multi-service fanout rollout to *prod* (staged). Services and tags:
- runtime -> r-2026-03-15 (commit r3f9b2a)
- api -> a-2026-03-15 (commit a8c1d4f)
- console -> c-2026-03-15 (commit c4b7e10)
Change window: 02:00-04:00 UTC. Rollout order: runtime (canary) -> api (canary) -> console. Canary size: 10% traffic. Release notes: https://confluence.redwood/release/2026-03-15 
/cc @maya @sam :rocket:

maya: On call & watching. Hold any auto-promotions until we see canaries. :eyes:

jon: Kicking off runtime canary now, scaling canary pods 3 -> 5.
Command: `kubectl -n runtime rollout status deploy/runtime-service-canary`

deploy-bot: runtime canary started (r3f9b2a). Logging shard -> https://logs.redwood/runtime/canary/r3f9b2a

jon: Quick smoke passed: p95 latency ~120ms, error rate 0.02%. Proceeding to api canary in 2 min.

lia: Starting api canary. Running DB migration job first: `job/api-db-migrate-20260315-canary`

lia: Migration job output:
```
START MIGRATION
Applying index: users_email_unique
ERROR: duplicate key value violates unique constraint "users_email_unique"
Migration failed, exit 1
```

lia: Migration failed on canary: duplicate emails found. Looks like the migration script doesn't check for pre-existing duplicates in this customer dataset.

sam: Oof. Hold everything else. Do not promote runtime to prod. @maya please confirm pause for console.

maya: Pause console rollout immediately. Do not promote api. Jon keep runtime at canary, do not scale to prod. :warning:

lia: Rolling back migration job and marking the canary as failed. I'll open a hotfix to make the migration idempotent and add a pre-check to detect dupes.

lia: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/api/pull/4512 — adds dedupe step + safe-index script. ETA for fix: ~25m.

sam: Starting DB snapshot before we attempt any fix re-run. Backup command:
```
pg_basebackup -h db-master -D /backups/bkp-20260315-01 -F tar
Backup id: bkp-20260315-01
```

deploy-bot: Aborting api canary rollout. Pinning api service to previous tag a-2026-03-14 (commit b7a9f0c). Rolling back canary replicas to stable.
Console rollout: paused. Runtime canary: frozen at current traffic share.

jon: Observability note: runtime KV cache saw a small spike during canary deployment but error budget unaffected. Keeping canary live for monitoring.

eva: Please add a short blurb to release notes about the migration pre-check being added. Also file a note for the post-release retro.

lia: Hotfix PR has been reviewed and merged. Tests green. I will re-run the migration in 30s after DB backup validation from @sam.

sam: Backup verified (bkp-20260315-01). Checksums match. OK to proceed on my side.

deploy-bot: Re-running api canary migration (hotfix) on a-2026-03-15-hf1 (commit a8c1d4f-hf1). Starting canary.

lia: Migration run output (excerpt):
```
Running pre-check: looking for duplicate emails... none found
Applying index: users_email_unique ... OK
Migration complete, exit 0
```

lia: API canary healthy. Health checks green, error rate 0.00% over 5m.

maya: Good. Promote api to prod canary -> stable. Then resume console rollout. Jon you can scale runtime to prod after api promotion completes.

deploy-bot: Promoting api to stable (a-2026-03-15). Commit: a8c1d4f-hf1. Promotion complete.

jon: Promoting runtime to prod now (r-2026-03-15). Scaling fleet and updating routing tables.

deploy-bot: Runtime promoted and serving 100% traffic. runtime commit r3f9b2a.

deploy-bot: Starting console rollout to prod (c-2026-03-15).

lia: Console pods coming up, health checks passing.

deploy-bot: Console rollout succeeded. All services on new releases:
- runtime: r-2026-03-15 (r3f9b2a)
- api: a-2026-03-15 (a8c1d4f-hf1)
- console: c-2026-03-15 (c4b7e10)

maya: :tada: Great execution. Please update the release notes with the migration fix details and add a short action item: run the pre-check on staging with a sampled dataset before next prod migration.

eva: I'll add the note and schedule a 1hr postmortem review for the migration workflow TOMORROW.

lia: Filing a small follow-up to improve the migration script and include a dry-run flag. PR link in release notes.

deploy-bot: Rollout complete. Closing thread. If anything regresses, open an incident and tag #incidents.
